error: decisive item is not a verbatim vignette span

decisive_items: directed an online-bought handheld high-intensity LED light at her right eye multiple times at very short distance with flash mode
Hyperreflective area at external retinal layers, disruption of ellipsoid zone, outer segment photoreceptor and interdigitation zone
Mosaic-like hyporeflective outer retinal space with flat RPE
response.rationale: High-intensity LED exposure with characteristic outer retinal OCT disruption and subsequent recovery indicates phototoxic maculopathy. Photoreceptor damage is the underlying tissue-level finding but less specific, while solar retinopathy is not supported because the exposure was to LED light, not direct sun.

rejected.why: Exposure was to a handheld LED light, not direct sun, and no raw support spans directly support solar retinopathy.
Photoreceptor damage matches the OCT findings but is a nonspecific tissue-level description rather than the specific clinical diagnosis of phototoxic maculopathy.
